paite: Misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw na kiang uah ka gelh akiphamoh kei hi.
heading: Misiangthoute A Dia Thilpiak
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

paite: Na kimandan uh ka thei ngal a, huai lam thu ah zaw nikum in Akhaia gamte kimansa in a-omta uh chi in Masidonia gam a mite kiang ah ka hon na suang zel a; na phattuamngaihna un alak ua mi tampi atok halhta hi.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

paite: Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw ka hon suanna bangmah lou ahong hihlouhna ding in unaute ka hohsak zel hi; ka gen bangtak a mansa a na na omtheihna ding un.
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw Masidonia gam a mi kuate hiam in ahon zuih zenzen uleh, kiman lou in hong mu le uh, noute kia hilou in noute ka hon ginna uh lam ah kou leng ka zahlak kha ding uhi.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute bel nou kiang a hong masa a, hoihtak a thilpiak na chiamkholhte uh na bawlkhol ding a, nget kiphamoh in ka gingta hi, laksak teitei bang hilou a phaltak a piak bang zaw a mansa a na omna ding un.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

paite: Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw, theh tawm in a-at tawm ding a, theh tam in a-at tam ding hi.
heading: Tuh Bangbang At Chiat Ding
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

paite: Michih in it pipi a pe lou in, piak louh theih louh a ngaihtuah a pe tuan lou in, alungtang ua atup bang zel un pe chiat uhen; Pathian in kipaktak a pe mite ahi a-it.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

paite: Huan Pathian in hehpihna chiteng in na tung uah avuk thei ahi; huchi in nou bangkim ah ahun ngial nei gige in, nasep hoih chiteng a ding in na hau thei ding uhi;
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

paite: "Ahawmzak a; gentheite kiang ah apia a; adiktatna tangtawn in a-om gige," chih gelh bang in.
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

paite: Thehpa kiang a achi pepa leh nek ding a tanghou pepa'n na theh ding uh chi ahon pe ding a, ahon hihpungsak ding a, na diktatna gahte uh leng ahon hihpungsak ding.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

paite: Thilphalna chiteng koute ziak a Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna pen nei ding a, bangkim a hihhauh a om in,
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

paite: hiai sepsakna nna in misiangthoute taksapna awngte ahuksak kia ahi kei a, Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna tampi in leng aluanglet lai ahi.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

paite: Hiai nasepna a etkhiak a om in Khrist tanchinhoih lam a na thugin uh na zuihdan uleh amau a ding leh mi tengteng a dia thilpiak a na thilphaldan un Pathian na hih thupi ding uh ahi.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

paite: Amau ngei in leng na tung ua Pathian hehpihna thupi mahmah ziak in, nou a dia thumsak kawm in ahon ngai mahmah uhi.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

paite: Athilpiak gen zoh vual louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
